reviews.experienceReview: No pleasure or satisfaction is awarded for this request, learning, registration, report creation, query, or repeated unchanged comparison. reviews.visualReview: Use a reusable report/observation overlay with metadata containing actor, reconciliation process ID, exact referenced IDs, evidence timestamp, access scope, completeness, phase, paid/remaining work and status such as pending, observed, historical-only, inaccessible or unresolved. Emit report-completed only after the paid comparison commits; completion means the review finished, not that an arrangement exists or recovery succeeded. Emit physical-observation-verified only after successful local verification. Failed or interrupted stages display their actual failure/pending status, never a success checkmark. Do not spawn a loose-wrap object, render an inferred location, show a restored material stack or mark the joining trial recovered. Any existing physical object's rendering remains tied to its actual observable state; private report contents are not automatically communicated to others.
reviews.specification: Implement one bounded, read-only reconciliation report, scoped to Lin, manual-88-lin-522, claimed arrangement loose-wrap-88-lin-523, item-66-lin-388 and item-76-lin-448. Record implementation reuse of source-bound-joining-trial@1 / long.joining and existing consult/probe record-access and observation code; this is a missing reconciliation adapter, not a new joining model. Prerequisites: Lin individually learns the adapter, supplies these exact references, and has legitimate access to the personal records examined. No new material or physical tool is required for record comparison. Before execution quote one actual review round costing 0.2 energy, consuming no materials. Invalid references or insufficient energy fail before charge. Review only accessible current personal records, their available complete paged contents, scoped source ownership/containment entries, relevant existing process transitions and already observable object references. Do not expose hidden objects, remote stock, undiscovered locations or other actors' private records. Missing or incomplete evidence must remain explicitly unavailable; an internal pointer is not permission to disclose a hidden location. Produce a dated personal report with exact evidence references, timestamps where available, completeness flags, recorded allocation/containment/recovery transitions, current supported access and an explicit list of unresolved contradictions. Distinguish historical completion from current existence, absence from the accessible observation index from physical nonexistence, listed inventory quantities from verified exclusive availability, and a process-map entry from an active work stage. In the initial evidence, identify the tick-89 completion claim, retained process marker, reported unsuccessful searches, and listed 0.9 vine plus two branches as conflicting or insufficient evidence, not a proven recovery. The listed source position (7.1,12.7) is not an arrangement location and does not by itself prove present reachability from Lin's tick-111 position. If record comparison identifies an already legitimately visible exact target or source, quote an optional separate local verification round at 0.2 energy before work. It requires live reach within the existing 0.65 interaction limit and applicable actual geometry/access checks; navigation is separate and paid under existing rules. Reuse existing probe observation, not a remote scan. This verifies only observable identity, location and containment; it cannot fabricate a missing physical object or reconstruct a hidden state. If unavailable or unsupported, finish with an unresolved report rather than adding broader search or restoration. Neither stage moves, reserves, splits, consumes, returns, duplicates or repairs matter; each source quantity must remain represented only in its actual existing containment. Conflicting inventory and placement claims are reported, not resolved by granting either stock or an arrangement. Report an available next operation only when supported by current state: source-bound-joining-trial inspect(arrangementId) costs one round/0.2 energy, or recover(arrangementId) costs one round/0.5 energy, each requiring a genuinely existing accessible exact arrangement. Existing individual learning for that ability remains two rounds at 0.2 energy per round if not already learned; the reconciliation adapter grants no mastery. Recovery remains a separate deliberate action preserving actual source identities, quantities and condition. Resume/cancel of old work requires the exact processId and a verified applicable existing stage; an orphan marker does not authorize either physical work or free recovery. Do not invoke assess, wrap, recover, repair or cleanup automatically. Reconciliation work has one atomic paid record stage and at most one separately authorized atomic local stage. Save completed report/progress under an exact new reconciliation process ID distinct from manual-88-lin-522. Interruption before a stage commits makes no charge or finding for that stage; after commit retain paid evidence. Resume revalidates access and performs only the outstanding authorized stage. Cancel or death ends outstanding reconciliation work without deleting historical reports, changing the original trial, relocating matter or refunding completed effort. No ongoing process, automatic retry, passive progress or maintenance charge. Development/review waiting advances no world time. The sole product is bounded dated evidence and conditional executable operation references, including an unresolved discrepancy when necessary; no strength, utility, comfort, nutrition, ownership, permission or mastery effect. Implement these checks and transitions in deterministic code rather than repeated model adjudication.

reviews.reason: The retrieved root-assessment@1 already supplies the requested bounded precursor: paid examination of an identified planted specimen, dated personal evidence, retained physical work and explicit limits on inference. Related placement, site and prepared-surface capabilities do not establish biological viability or propagation. The request expressly permits unknown findings, so neither a new viability mechanism nor duplicate assessment development is necessary. Persistence of the original specimen is not proof of viability; elapsed observation rounds are not proof of growth, deterioration or death.
reviews.experienceReview: Assessment, learning, requests, naming and reaching an observation interval do not themselves earn pleasure or satisfaction. Repeated unchanged findings earn no information-gain benefit. A genuinely informative observed change or informative negative result may be considered only by the existing single grounded-understanding/evidence-deduplicated rule, with personal applicability, its existing bounded amount, cap, decay and cooldown; this reuse adds no reward rule or separate reward for the same evidence. An unsupported or inconclusive query alone is not verified information gain. No comfort, nutrition, health or energy restoration is supplied. Protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions remain unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Keep functional evidence distinct from presentation and experience. Reuse the actual root plot's plant component and existing appearance; use observable work events and retained exposure/progress to distinguish examination begun, uncovered, interrupted, covered and completed findings. Evidence metadata should reference the target ID, processId, tick, method, completed stage and supported finding or unknown status so it can be reused without implying a new physical effect. A covered plot or completed inspection must not display germination, a viable-plant badge, food, propagation or a successful diagnosis unsupported by observation. Failed access produces no examination-success event; interrupted inspection may show only the exposure and work actually completed. Public visuals disclose only observable physical events, not Moss's private report or concealed specimen properties.
reviews.specification: Reuse root-assessment@1, handler long.root-assessment, equivalence planted-root:paid-inspection:1; record this reuse rather than claiming a new implementation. Use its existing modes begin, observe, inspect, resume and cancel. Require an explicit exact target, either root-trial-10-moss-48 or root-trial-101-moss-602, and validate current physical reach and access before examination; a remembered record or target name alone is insufficient. Each plot is examined separately. Only the creator may handle a plot; reachable public-state observation does not authorize handling. No prerequisite abilities, resources or knowledge dependencies are declared, but Moss must individually complete the existing learning requirement; this review grants neither mastery nor execution. Begin/observe costs one actual round and 0.2 energy. Begin records an external baseline and claims the personal work lock. Inspect costs two paid work rounds at one energy each, uncovering the existing reserved specimen, recording its actually accessible condition and replacing the displaced soil. No tools, water, replacement root or consumable sampling materials are supplied or required. Do not add destructive cutting, extraction or laboratory testing to this version. Preserve the original specimen identity, provenance and all displaced soil; output is evidence, not new matter, edible stock, fertility or biomass. Reports must carry the execution tick, target and available input-item/provenance references, examination method, actual exposure, completed work and observational limits. Distinguish original specimen present, directly observed deterioration, directly observed new structure, and unresolved identity or condition only as supported by accessible evidence; absence of represented evidence is not evidence of absence. Do not infer that an additional structure is an independent propagated plant or that a persistent root is alive. The older root's earlier finding of only the original specimen remains a historical observation, not a current finding. The second plot's surface-38-moss-234 association is not a viability certificate. When the examination cannot resolve viability, new growth or propagation, report unknown explicitly. Retain exact plot, processId, remaining inspection rounds, exposure and paid effort across interruption; resume revalidates access and pays only outstanding work. Explicit cancel or death settles the lock once without automatically covering exposed material or refunding spent energy/time. Cancellation does not convert the planted root into inventory. Existing specimen ageing continues while unattended, including while exposed; disclose the physical disturbance and exposure risk without inventing a risk probability. Completed evidence and physical changes persist. No passive assessment, tending effect, automatic reinspection or maintenance benefit is created. Further examination requires another actual paid action. Personal evidence is shared only through actual communication; other participants must act independently. Development/review waiting advances no world time. Established checks, accounting, progress and evidence limitations execute in the existing code, not repeated model adjudication.

reviews.reason: Develop a minimal nondestructive, source-bound specimen examination in the current-conversation handoff. Related capability searches were performed. The exact probe schema and handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, offer generic observation or material-consuming tests, but the reported observation returned null plant-state fields rather than specimen evidence. Root-assessment requires a planted plot; joining assessments concern different inputs and geometry. None of the retrieved implementations establishes equivalent owned-nut examination. Reuse applicable access, observation, accounting and evidence code with explicit provenance rather than presenting it as reinvention. Missing specimen observation support is a development task, not evidence about the nut or a reason for permanent rejection. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: One personal study round at 0.2 energy, separately initiated and paid; learning, naming, requesting, registration and completion alone award no wellbeing. This precursor supplies no automatic pleasure, satisfaction or comfort. A committed observation that genuinely adds verified, personally applicable information, including an informative access or visibility failure, may be submitted once to the existing evidence-based understanding rule only if that rule is available with executable cap, decay and cooldown; otherwise award zero. Deduplicate by specimen, observed property/state revision and evidence, including equivalent probe observations, not ability name. Repetition of unchanged evidence gives no information-gain award. No new reward schedule or protected-account mutation is authorized. No nutrition, satiety, health or safety benefit follows examination; basic nutrition is not reduced by mood. Physical comfort is not produced and remains capped at 10 under existing rules.
reviews.visualReview: Keep evidence and functional results separate from presentation. Emit an observable inspection-start event only when actual inspection begins, followed by completed, unavailable or interrupted status matching real execution; a failed or incomplete action cannot display success. Reusable metadata must include component specimen-examination, event/process ID, actor, exact specimen ID, tick, actual location, progress 0/1 or 1/1, status, observed-property references and visibility/uncertainty flags. A completion marker means only the paid examination occurred, never safe, edible, opened or prepared. Render only supported visible exterior details and already exposed interior; unknown content stays occluded and cannot gain an invented kernel, crack or healthy-state image. No persistent world object or duplicate nut is created by an evidence annotation. Detailed findings stay personal unless Lin independently communicates them; nearby actors may perceive actual handling through ordinary visibility, without receiving private findings or mastery. Visuals themselves award no experience.
reviews.specification: Implement examine(specimenId=item-119-lin-699) as one separately initiated, nondestructive examination, not automatic execution on registration or learning. Scope: Lin's existing quantity-1 specimen, origin start-0-nuts, harvestedAt 119; source identity and origin do not establish shell state, composition, food safety or preparation requirements. Prerequisites: Lin alive and independently initiating the action, personally learned ability, current ownership of the surviving exact specimen, actual local access within 0.65 plus body radius, adequate visibility and unobstructed manual handling, and at least 0.2 energy. Revalidate all at execution; the supplied item position is not proof Lin is nearby. No tools, water, heat, containers or other materials are provided or assumed; this version needs none. Cost: one work round and 0.2 energy for a committed examination; zero material consumption. No travel included. Atomic execution: validate and take a transient identity lock, perform inspection, then commit cost, event and dated private report together. No advance charge or partial physical transformation. Interruption, cancellation, lost access or death before commit produces no examination finding or success, releases the lock and costs no examination energy; elapsed ordinary world time is not refunded. Retrying explicitly revalidates and pays for a new completed examination. After commit, spent time and energy are not refunded and the dated report persists under ordinary record rules; the item follows existing ownership/death rules, never remote return. No persistent escrow, passive work or maintenance. During actual inspection permit only ordinary nondamaging viewing and gentle reorientation, leaving the same specimen at its actual site. Record only visible exterior shape, color, texture, visible damage, openings and exposed material that the physical implementation can genuinely resolve. Approximate scale must identify its reference and uncertainty; no inferred exact mass or dimension. Distinguish observed shell-like covering from confirmed internal anatomy. Interior observation is permitted only through an already present, genuinely visible opening without widening, peeling, breaking or separating it. Unimplemented or occluded features are explicitly unavailable, never null fields translated into healthy, intact, edible or unsafe. Handoff must implement a bounded direct-observation adapter where absent, not fabricate hidden anatomy or make a label-based safety lookup. If only access or coverage limits are demonstrable, the paid report records those limits and leaves condition unresolved. Report includes event/process ID, tick, actor, exact specimen ID, observed quantity and current source revision, method, viewing conditions, findings with uncertainty, unavailable fields and reasons, and comparison with any personally retained source-linked baseline. An intact covering that blocks inspection supports only 'interior inaccessible by this method; a separate opening/preparation trial is needed to examine it,' not 'must prepare before eating.' Where covering or preparation needs remain unknown, say so. No tasting, consumption, opening, heating, pressing, wetting or sampling is authorized. Any such trial requires a separate explicit action with identified real tools/materials, feasible mechanism and paid conserved work before execution; do not execute or invent that trial here. Input/output conservation: one original specimen remains one original specimen with unchanged quantity, no parts, food, stock or transformed product created; existing ageing continues normally. The only new product is an evidence record, not a certificate. Current decay metadata is neither a visible symptom nor a safety finding. Record code reuse against open.probe/foundation-open@1 and any actual reused runtime components, preserving their original scope; do not claim root or joining mechanics were performed. Encode access, costs, deduplication, interruption and observation limits in executable rules rather than repeated model review. Development/review waiting advances no world time and grants neither mastery nor execution, consent or permission.

A completed assessment may qualify only for genuinely new personally applicable verified exterior evidence, or an actually informative method limitation established by the paid examination; merely printing the predeclared inability to prove safety does not qualify. Reuse the existing grounded-understanding rule only if its actual executable contract is present: short source 0.8, aggregate cap 1, duration 8, cooldown 12, maintained gain 0.035 with decay 0.0015, subject to that rule's personal applicability and aggregation checks. If no such rule exists, award zero rather than creating a reward mechanism here. Deduplicate by canonical specimen, property, evidence state and method across probe and equivalent assessments; unchanged repetition gives no new gain. Familiar practice is not disqualified merely for lacking novelty, but this precursor grants no additional practice reward without an applicable existing bounded rule. No automatic pleasure, comfort, health, energy recovery, satiety or nutrition is produced; basic nutrition is not reduced by mood, physical comfort remains capped at 10, and protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions are unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Emit an assessment-start/abort or assessment-completed event only when the corresponding execution actually occurs. Reuse existing interaction rendering where supported and attach reusable visual metadata: actorId, specimenId, originId, eventId, method=exterior-observe, observedTick, stage, outcome, evidenceRefs and limitations. Completed means the observation/report completed, never that the food is safe. Render unavailable and inconclusive findings distinctly from affirmative measured findings; do not show safe/edible badges, internal anatomy, toxin readings or nutrition bars unsupported by evidence. Failed validation or interrupted work cannot display a completed assessment or award a success effect. Keep detailed findings private until Sol actually communicates them; public animation shows only the performed handling. Preserve the apple's actual appearance and ordinary ageing, with no invented glow, opening, damage, harvested stock or permanent marker.
reviews.specification: Current-conversation development handoff: implement a bounded, non-destructive exterior assessment and evidence-limit report, not an edibility test. Initial exact target is item-125-sol-735, owner sol, resource apple, quantity 1, origin forest-apple-2, harvestedAt 125. forest-apple-2 is provenance, not an additional input; its current stock 14 and mature stage do not certify the specimen. Revalidate actual identity, ownership, availability, local physical access, visibility, unreserved status and energy at execution; a stored position alone is not proof of access. An invalid or inaccessible target fails before payment and yields no observation. No tools, water, reagent, heat source, additional fruit or birch are supplied or needed. Study costs one personal round and 0.2 energy. Assess(specimenId, evidenceRefs=[]) costs one atomic work round and 0.2 energy for gentle exterior viewing/reorientation and recording; no tasting, deliberate sniffing of unknown material, skin challenge, pressing, wetting, heating, opening or sample removal. Record reuse of open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, handler open.probe, for the actual observe interaction where compatible; do not additionally charge a second probe action. Reuse the owned-hazelnut-assessment exterior-evidence machinery only after checking its implementation and adapting source applicability, not by copying hazelnut anatomy into an apple. Evidence references must be exact, complete, already personally accessible records; omitted, paged-incomplete or unavailable records remain unavailable. Obtaining further evidence uses separate actual consult actions under foundation-open@1 or independent communication; no automatic search of private records or hidden resource definitions. This release reports only represented, perceptible exterior features from a versioned source-appropriate observation model. If that model lacks a feature, report unavailable rather than invent it. Approximate body-scale geometry, if supported by the reused model, retains its resolution 0.02 and uncertainty 0.01 world-distance units and explicit model limitations; do not claim calibrated measurement. Never disclose decay=1.36461198 as an observed symptom or infer toxins, composition, interior health or nutritional value from private engine fields. The dated personal report has separate sections for performed method and direct exterior observations, supplied evidence relevant to identification/edibility, supported preparation information, and remaining uncertainty. Attach exact event and evidence references, observed tick, specimen identity and limitations to each claim. The word apple, a mature source, intact appearance or lack of visible damage does not establish food safety, nutrition or absence of toxins. With only the supplied facts, report that available methods cannot establish safety and that preparation requirements remain unestablished; do not invent washing, cooking or other effective treatment. No ingestion or eat invocation is included. Conservation: the same single specimen remains under the same ownership and location, with no material consumed, duplicated, restored or generated; no tree stock changes. Existing ageing and environmental rules continue normally. Output is a personal dated evidence record, not food, a safety certificate or a new specimen. Atomic work commits payment and observation together; interruption before commit creates no paid finding or charge, and resumption requires a fresh validated action. Cancellation before commit costs no inspection energy; after commit the record and paid effort persist with no refund. Death before commit aborts the action and leaves matter to ordinary death/ownership handling; death after commit never restores energy or specimen condition. No long-running task, reservation beyond the atomic interaction, passive assessment, maintenance charge or automatic reassessment exists. Later reassessment costs a new action and preserves earlier dated records rather than overwriting history. Review/development waiting advances no world time. Implement validation, conservation, uncertainty, evidence restrictions and lifecycle rules in code rather than requiring repeated model approval. No inventory, personal mastery, permission, consent, protection change or reward-account change is granted by this review.

reviews.experienceReview: Lin must study individually for one active round at 0.2 energy; registration and learning grant no mastery reward. Assessment provides no nutrition, health, physical comfort or automatic pleasure/satisfaction. A genuinely new verified observation, including an informative observed failure of accessibility, may invoke only the existing grounded-understanding rule: short source amount 0.8, cap 1, duration 8, cooldown 12; maintained gain 0.035 with decay 0.0015. Inspect(processId): one active round at 0.2 energy, observing only surfaces actually exposed and reachable by nondestructive viewing. Inputs unavailable or energy insufficient before the next contact pause before payment; no unpaid partial contact. Cancel or death releases locks exactly once at actual positions; irreversible changes and paid effort persist, with no energy, material or condition refund and no remote return. Precommit cancellation/death of an atomic assessment or inspection produces neither its charge nor its report. A fresh request, assessment or process cannot reset prior contacts. No passive work, automatic reinspection, maintenance benefit or unattended contacts; paused items remain physical objects subject to ordinary processes. reviews.reason: Develop the smallest source-bound assessment and recovery precursor. Related capabilities have been searched. moss-source-bound-hazelnut-interior-access-trial already supplies inspection and process release, which must be reused rather than reinvented. opened-hazelnut-preparation-assessment supplies related assessment machinery but is bound to a different specimen and requires an owned unreserved assembly; source-bound-opened-hazelnut-access-trial likewise has different source bindings and only permits exterior rim contact. Neither establishes access to this actual completed, possibly still locked assembly. Add a paid assessment of current reachable access, locks and supported handling prerequisites, with an explicit route to existing release and pickup. Do not introduce an unsupported separation operation. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Moss studies individually for one active round costing 0.2 energy; no existing or new mastery is granted by this review. Study, requests, assessment registration, release and pickup earn no experience benefit by themselves. This precursor grants zero pleasure, maintained satisfaction, practice or comfort reward: repeated exposure and reports of missing mechanisms do not establish new information gain. Any future qualifying verified observation, including an informative physical failure, must use an existing applicable coded rule with personal relevance, canonical specimen/property/state deduplication, amount/cap, cooldown and decay; it must not create a reward account. No protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions change; nutrition is not mood-scaled and no physical-comfort increase is granted.
reviews.visualReview: Reuse actual specimen, stone and support visuals without inventing anatomy or revealed contents. Emit assessment-completed, assessment-unresolved/blocked and process-release events only for the actions actually committed, citing actor, tick, source IDs/revisions, process ID, action status and report ID. Reusable visual metadata should include component=assessment-overlay, target references, state, evidence-event references, observed-region reference where actually supported, resolution/uncertainty and a label such as 'Limited exposure; separation unresolved'. Keep the detailed report personal. An overlay is UI metadata, not a material object. Display unlocked/released status only after verified release; display recovered/carried status only after successful baseline pickup. No opened-whole-interior, detached-food, safety, success sparkle or completed-trial imagery for incomplete, blocked or unsupported actions. No passive visual refresh or beneficial ongoing effect.
reviews.specification:
Development handoff: implement a source-bound exposed-assembly prerequisite assessment, recording code reuse from moss-source-bound-hazelnut-interior-access-trial for process identity, inspection boundaries, lifetime contact ledger and release; from opened-hazelnut-preparation-assessment for private evidence-limited reports; and from baseline pickup for local recovery. These are dependencies, not newly invented functions. Bind references to actor moss, specimen item-140-moss-811 from forest-hazelnut-1, stone item-171-moss-994, support start-2-stone, completed process manual-178-moss-1044 and optional complete personal record nut-opening:manual-178-moss-1044. Resolve actual live records at execution; the supplied fragments do not establish their current locations, reservations or full geometry. Never create replacement inputs or grant mastery.
Modes: assess(processId, specimenId, toolId, supportId, evidenceRefs up to eight exact complete personal keys) and explicitly selected release(processId). Assess costs one active round and 0.5 energy, with zero material consumption, wear, displacement or reservations. Validate process/source lineage, lawful observational access, reach and sufficient energy before charging. Observation of an assembly held by this actor's original process is allowed only through that process's existing inspection authorization; a conflicting lock is reported, not bypassed. An owned inventory item is not required merely to assess the supported local assembly. Empty inventory is not evidence that the assembly or tool has vanished. Assess is atomic: no partial paid report or work accrues before commit. Absent targets, failed access or insufficient energy produce a bounded failure without an assessment charge; missing geometric support after a valid paid observation is reported as unresolved, not as successful physical access.
Report dated actual locations/access status, process status, reservation owner and release eligibility relevant to the actor's own process, reachable visible surfaces and supported external clearance. Do not expose unrelated private state or hidden material properties. Distinguish the tick-180 observation of discontinuity and limited pale compact surface from a new observation; neither establishes the whole interior, a kernel, edible material, an aperture large enough for handling, detachability or safety. Use the existing geometry resolution 0.02 and uncertainty 0.01 only where its response model supports observation; otherwise record unavailable geometry. Preserve exact source revisions and event/evidence citations. Report whether existing local pickup of the whole assembly and tool is supported after release; do not infer that support from proximity to the stone alone. A separation-readiness section identifies missing actual actuator, clearance, retention model, support or receiver only as applicable and unresolved, without fabricating prerequisites or issuing an executable separation quote. No impact, prying, internal insertion, sampling or trial is authorized by assessment.
Release is a separately selected delegation to the existing cancel/release contract of moss-source-bound-hazelnut-interior-access-trial for manual-178-moss-1044, including a completed process when its locks remain. Add no material, energy or work charge to that existing administrative release and no physical pickup. Validate authority and live process state; atomically release only that process's remaining locks once at the actual assembly/tool locations. Repeated release is an idempotent no-op. If completed-state dispatch currently prevents the contractually promised release, repair that dispatch in the existing process handler rather than creating a second release ledger. Retain paid contacts, irreversible exposure, tool wear, provenance and ordinary ageing. Both opening contacts remain exhausted permanently; cancellation, recovery and learning never reset them. If locks are already clear, report that fact without moving anything. Existing local pickup must subsequently be chosen for each surviving item, independently validating reach, access and carrying limits and using its established time/energy terms. No remote return, restoration, duplicate item or free stock.
Conservation: assembly quantity remains one retained source assembly, with all represented matter and internal bookkeeping retained; tool remains the same actual stone and support is not consumed. Assessment/release output only a private evidence report and observable process-state events, not shell/kernel fractions, food, debris, tool repair or new material. No separation in this release. A later explicitly requested conserved trial can enter development with its actual response model, force/work bound, inputs, output accounting and failure behavior; it is not rejected merely because a primitive is presently absent.
Work/lifecycle: study and assessment require actual actor time, with no progress during review/development waiting. Assessment has no ongoing process, escrow or maintenance. Interruption, cancellation or death before its atomic commit produces no report or assessment charge; completed effort and records are not refunded. Release is atomic and idempotent; death cleanup follows the original process's once-only local release contract. Original process progress survives interruptions and recovery, and no consumed effort is refunded. Existing ageing and other ordinary ongoing processes continue only when world time actually advances. Enforce these conditions in executable validation and lifecycle code, not repeated model review. No automatic physical work, communication, ingestion, healing, nutrition or benefit is supplied.
